div.span:
1 an alarm or event reaches the front door
2 it starts or joins an incident workflow
3 the zones pick up their steps
4 read the evidence (read-only role)
5 ask the model (redacted facts only)
6 report in Slack
7 a person approves the exact plan
8 apply once, check, undo if it failed
9 everything is recorded and signed
